newsitem.title: USA: INTERVIEW - Pioneer plans exploration acquisitions.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Pioneer plans exploration acquisitions.

text.p: Pioneer Natural Resources Co, the $3 billion company that will be formed through merger of Mesa Inc and Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co, is set to make exploration and production acquisitions, Parker & Parsley executive vice president Tim Leach told Reuters.
"We are poised to make future acquistions. This is just the start," he said.

Parker & Parsley and Mesa said Monday they would merge to form the third largest independent oil and gas producer in the U.S. with reserves of 1.9 trillion cubic feet of natural gas and 293 million barrels of oil.
Leach said Monday the new company will drill 700 wells per year and spend $100 million on exploration.
"We are looking overseas, our main areas for exploration will be South America, Canada and the Gulf of Mexico."

He said the company will have over half a billion dollars in annual cash flow and the mixture of long-life oil and gas reserves of Pioneer would result in stable production and remove some of the commodity risk for the company.
Leach said Pioneer expects to maintain an investment grade rating and the merged company would have improved access to the equity markets.
